status: local draft; no cloud flow created

trigger.meaning: The app passes only the saved case row ID. The flow re-reads all values from Dataverse.

reads: Get the case row by caseId.

Continue only when processingstatus is 開始受付済み. The Canvas save step sets 保存済み; a separate accepted start changes it to 開始受付済み. A canceled, merely saved, already processing, or already transferred case exits without writing.
List document notes related to the case; continue only if exactly one attachment exists.
Read the source note filename and Base64 documentbody.
List active destination rows matching the environment/server pair; continue only when exactly one row matches.
checks: Check that the case has environment, server, positive integer run number, and target date.
Decode the note body as UTF-8; require the first line to be 処理日: YYYY-MM-DD and require the date to equal targetdate.
Require the log body environment, server, and run number to match the saved case.
writes: Set processingstatus to 処理中 before external file work.
Copy the prepared workbook to the fixed T006 relative folder path as <caseId>.xlsx with overwrite disabled.
Use the copied workbook's Evidence table. Replace the __TEMPLATE__ row with the first chunk and add one row per remaining chunk.
Split at 30000 UTF-16 code units without separating a surrogate pair. Store ChunkIndex and ChunkCount.
Read the Evidence rows back, order by ChunkIndex, and compare case ID, filename, four fields, and reconstructed full text.
On an exact match, set processingstatus=転記済み, excelcheckstatus=全文一致, and excelurl to the copied file URL.

On validation failure, set processingstatus=停止 and failurereason. If a copied workbook exists but the write/read outcome cannot be established, set processingstatus=結果不明 and do not start a second copy.

result_contract.return_to_canvas: No direct response is required; Canvas re-reads the case row.

first_pass_limits: One fixed T006 destination folder; the mapping table is still checked for the environment/server pair.
Stop when a case has zero or multiple attached document notes.
No server-side API validation of Text choice values.
A prior run's file must be investigated manually if the result is unknown.
